connector.name: Roxels
connector.registryDescription: Let AI agents create configurable voice agents via meeting rooms and return structured data.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package roxels-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.roxels. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ROXELS_API_KEY
env.description: Your Roxels API key (sk-...). Get one at https://app.roxels.ai, Settings, API Keys.

env.name: ROXELS_API_URL
env.description: API base URL. Override for self-hosted or development.
